claim: utility of explicit syscall feature channels, not globally optimal syscall subset

normal_data.selection_capture: new per-ID histogram, separate from final evaluation
normal_data.train_and_calibration: normal-only; same temporal split and source intervals for every variant
normal_data.test: new independent sealed normal capture, disjoint by source/hash/time from selection/train/calibration
normal_data.workloads: all 21 frozen workload/container keys; report missing coverage explicitly
normal_data.regime_labels_source: actual traffic orchestration receipts, not inferred retrospectively from syscall scores
normal_data.full_histogram: exact syscall-ID entry counts; cannot invert existing hash bins
normal_data.integrity: record allowed cgroups, IDs/ABI, duration, overflow/drop/map-cardinality and snapshot boundaries
normal_data.normal_labels: benign evidence/adjudication required; unknown intervals not TN

classifier_variants.reference: current explicit 29 + other + bins + rolling features
classifier_variants.individual_ablation: 29 retrained variants, each masks log_count/ratio/rolling_mean/rolling_std for one explicit syscall
classifier_variants.no_explicit_channels: mask all explicit per-syscall channels; retain aggregate channels as disclosed
classifier_variants.frequency_selection: top-K only from selection/training normal, with fixed rare-security whitelist; K=16 and K=29
classifier_variants.full_id_counts_candidate: separate feature schema/model from future full histogram; cannot reuse frozen 249-dimensional model
classifier_variants.calibration: each retrained variant uses calibration only; never test scores/attack labels
classifier_variants.residual_information: ID evidence can remain in hash bins, sensitive_ratio and unchanged policy; masking explicit channels is not removal of all syscall information
classifier_variants.gate_policy: unchanged reference policy, with compatible exact-count evidence; report policy contribution separately

attack_evaluation.safety: no external network, persistent writes, successful mount or privilege changes
attack_evaluation.case_catalog_and_start_schedule: must be bound in separate START before execution; not launched by this plan

metrics.primary_unit: preregistered scenario interval; normal interval lengths and incident grouping fixed before test
metrics.no_detection_latency: misses/censored outcomes kept; latency among detections reported with denominator
metrics.missing_attack_telemetry: miss in end-to-end recall plus separate conditional-telemetry recall
metrics.normal_alerts: retain every alert, including infrastructure-degraded intervals, adjudicate and stratify after run
metrics.interval_estimation: 95% paired block/bootstrap by trial/workload or time blocks, not IID syscall/window bootstrap
metrics.multiple_comparisons: Holm correction for the preregistered ablation family
metrics.performance_permutation_importance: paired held-out labeled performance, not mean score displacement on normal-only data

selection_rule: Use development data for engineering choices. Report final blind trade-offs with confidence intervals; never tune and rerun against the same blind test to claim improvement. If inconclusive, keep the conclusion inconclusive.
